RETROSPECTIVE ARCHITECTURE DECISION · 11 OCTOBER 2026

ADR-0014: CockroachDB is mandatory for development deployment

Status

Accepted and enforced at service entry points

Context

SQLite adapter tests were useful earlier but must not masquerade as a working CockroachDB development lab.

Decision

Container deployment uses CockroachDB only. Live UI mode is supplied by gateway configuration, not hostname guessing. API/dependency failure must remain visible, with no SQLite or browser-simulation fallback.

Alternatives

Silently use SQLite or browser memory when the API/database fails.

Consequences

Docker and working CockroachDB services are prerequisites. The explicitly selected historical SQLite unit-test adapter is retained as prior work, excluded from deployment and acceptance claims. Invoke the pinned CockroachDB binary directly; its image initialization wrapper rejects the internal all-interface listen address. SQL ports remain internal.

Evidence

compose.yaml; infra/lab-config.live.json; poc/app.py; dist/lab-mode.mjs

Gate

Ready checks identify CockroachDB; tests reject alternate live modes and unavailable configuration.
